messages:
Alex G: Hi payroll — I noticed Social Security withholding on my 08/30 bonus even though my YTD wages already exceeded the 2024 SS wage base. EmpID 006789. Can someone check?
Jade (Payroll): Thanks Alex. Can you paste the bonus paystub line or screenshot (redact SSN)? Which payroll run was this?
Alex G: Run date 2024-08-30. Screenshot attached (gross bonus 5,000; SS W/H $310.00).
payroll-bot: Payroll run #2024-08-30 completed for Redwood US. 3,210 employees processed.
Jade (Payroll): Looking at your YTD — you hit the SS cap on 07/15 per our records. The bonus was flagged as "supplemental_regular" instead of "supplemental_nontaxablecap" in the tax code mapping, so SS was withheld erroneously.
Maria HR: Yikes. Is this isolated to your record or systemic?
Jade (Payroll): Preliminary scan: 4 other employees had the same supplemental flag in that run. We'll extract list and scope. For you Alex, we can issue a retro refund for the SS amount and correct YTD totals.
Alex G: Will this change my W-2? Do I need to do anything with the IRS/SSA?
Jade (Payroll): Good q. We'll reclass the withheld SS as a refund/adjustment in our payroll provider. That will reduce your employee SS withholding YTD and update employer Social Security tax. If this impacts year-end reporting we'll issue a corrected W-2c so SSA has the right amounts. No action needed from you for SSA — we'll handle reporting.
Alex G: Any timeline?
Jade (Payroll): Plan: 1) collect quick confirmation DM from affected employees (authorizes refund). 2) Run off-cycle corrective payroll to refund SS withholding within 2 pay cycles. 3) Reconcile employer match and remit adjustments to SSA if required. 4) Track W-2 impacts and prepare W-2c if the calendar year is closed.
Maria HR: @Jade (Payroll) please also add a short note in the payroll runbook explaining the supplemental tax mapping and the QA step we missed. @Eng-Platform FYI — looks like the supplemental -> tax-flag mapping was changed in the import on 08/20.
payroll-bot: Ticket PR-7480 created: "Supplemental tax flag caused SS withholding after wage cap" assigned to payroll_team. Priority: Medium-High.
Jade (Payroll): I'll DM you the confirmation form and add you to the incident thread. Will post updates here once the refund is scheduled.
Alex G: Thanks — appreciate the quick response :thumbsup:
